stepTitle: When serving a tennis ball, a player hits the ball when its velocity is zero (at the highest point of a vertical toss). The racquet exerts a force of $$540\, \text{N}$$ on the ball for $$5.00\, \text{ms}, $$ giving it a final velocity of $$45.0\,\text{m/s}.$$ Using these data, find the mass of the ball (in $$\text{g})$$.
